content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: FDDI describes itself as an Institution of National Importance under the aegis of the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. This engagement is at its Head Office, with the address given in the notice at Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The notice says the engagement is meant to provide academic and administrative support to the academic functions of FDDI and to address urgent institutional requirements.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Junior Faculty, in the School of Footwear Design & Production (FDP), domain Component, Lasting & Finishing. The upper age limit is 35 years; the notice prints no date as on which age is counted and no age relaxation. Option (i): Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree (of minimum 02 years duration after Graduation) in any field with minimum 55% marks from a recognized University/Institute; and Diploma (of minimum 01 year duration) in Footwear Manufacturing / Footwear Technology / Footwear Design & Production / Footwear Production / Accessories Design / Footwear Science & Engineering from a recognized University/Institute. OR option (ii): Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Footwear Manufacturing / Footwear Technology / Footwear Design & Production / Footwear Production / Accessories Design / Footwear Science & Engineering / Engineering with minimum 55% marks from a recognized University/Institute. Preference will be given to candidates with a degree in Science, in case of option (i) of the essential qualification. Academic and/or industry experience of at least 03 years in the field of footwear assembly (Components / Lasting / Finishing). Academic experience, if any, should be of teaching in UG degree or higher academic courses. Candidates with experience in assembly (Components / Lasting / Finishing) in the footwear industry will be given preference. Candidates with experience working in assembly lines, bottom component, sole department or rubber room in a footwear industry will be given preference. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Junior Faculty receives a consolidated remuneration of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) per month. Initial engagement is for a period of up to 06 months. The engagement may be extended, if required, for further periods of up to 06 months at a time through fresh engagement, subject to institutional requirements and approval of the competent authority. Performance and compliance with assigned responsibilities are reviewed periodically by the management, and the reviews are taken into consideration while assessing any requirement for re-engagement. Two Casual Leaves per month. Unutilized Casual Leave may be carried forward within the current engagement period of six months. Casual Leave not availed during the engagement period lapses. No Earned Leave or Leave Encashment is admissible. No entitlement towards HRA, House Allocation, LTC, Medical Reimbursement, or any other benefits not specifically mentioned in the notice. Temporary hostel/house accommodation may be provided, subject to availability and at the discretion of the Institute, on payment of prescribed charges. If allotted, it must be vacated within 15 days from the date of discontinuation of engagement. FDDI attendance rules and travel entitlements for official duties apply as per the norms of the Institute. Attendance is ordinarily required for five working days per week. The engaged person may be required to attend office on weekends or holidays due to operational exigencies. Compensatory Off, wherever admissible, is governed by the prevailing rules of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: FDDI Junior Faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: Perform duties and functions of the assigned role in accordance with institutional requirements and academic objectives. Assist the Head of Academics and/or Head of School in planning, coordination, implementation, monitoring and review of academic programmes and related activities. Liaise with faculty members, students and administrative departments for smooth conduct of academic programmes, examinations, workshops, seminars and institutional events. Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Academics, Head of School or competent authority from time to time. Adhere to all policies, rules, regulations and guidelines of FDDI as amended and notified from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for FDDI Junior Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: The application must reach FDDI within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The advertisement is dated 4 November 2026, so the date is about 19 November 2026 (15 days from 4 November 2026).

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for FDDI Junior Faculty?
faq.answer: Either a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any field with minimum 55% marks plus a Diploma of minimum 01 year in a footwear subject, or a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a footwear subject or Engineering with minimum 55% marks. At least 03 years of experience in footwear assembly is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for FDDI Junior Faculty?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, as printed in the English version of the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of FDDI Junior Faculty?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for FDDI Junior Faculty?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format with a detailed CV, self-attested qualification copies, experience certificates, proof of age and other relevant documents by Speed Post to Dy. Manager (HO-HR), Administrative Block, 4th Floor, Room No. 405, FDDI, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201301.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected for FDDI Junior Faculty?
faq.answer: Selection is made through interview. Only shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is the FDDI Junior Faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is an ad-hoc engagement, with an initial period of up to 06 months. It may be extended for further periods of up to 06 months at a time through fresh engagement, subject to institutional requirements and approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q8. Are HRA and other allowances paid with the ₹50,000 remuneration?
faq.answer: No. The notice says there is no entitlement to HRA, House Allocation, LTC, Medical Reimbursement or any other benefit not specifically mentioned. Temporary hostel or house accommodation may be provided on payment of prescribed charges, subject to availability and the Institute's discretion.

faq.question: Q9. How many leaves does the FDDI Junior Faculty get?
faq.answer: The Junior Faculty gets two Casual Leaves per month. Unused leave may be carried forward within the current six-month engagement period and lapses if not availed. No Earned Leave or Leave Encashment is admissible.

faq.question: Q10. Will late applications be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered, and incomplete applications or those not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected.
